title: A novel explainable machine learning-based healthy ageing scale
summary: The study constructs an explainable healthy-ageing scale from physical, social and mental domains and reports its learned feature contributions, a concrete gerontology measurement result. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: The study constructs an explainable healthy-ageing scale from physical, social and mental domains and reports its learned feature contributions, a concrete gerontology measurement result.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: Explainable XGBoost and factor-analysis procedures derive a healthy-ageing scale from 696 adults and 82 survey items selected with gerontology experts.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
